title: The signal that returned to its own archive

chapters.label: REM618
chapters.title: Prima materia
chapters.text: A signal enters the field before the system knows what it will become. The first web chamber remains preserved rather than overwritten.

chapters.label: INTERVAL
chapters.title: The part that should not be invented
chapters.text: Between emission and return there are records, artifacts and missing pieces. The Grimoire keeps the missing interval visible instead of converting absence into mythology.

chapters.title: Coagula
chapters.text: The second object does not replace the first. It makes the first legible as part of a larger system and carries its own provenance forward.

chapters.label: RETURN
chapters.title: The experiment observes itself
chapters.text: The system returns to the old signal and waits. What appears next is not yet known. That uncertainty is part of the work.

chapters.title: Unresolved
chapters.text: The next chapter is deliberately unwritten. It depends on what the return reveals, fails to reveal, or contradicts.
